BTS Group Pays Homage to His Majesty King Bhumibol Adulyadej The Great on Nawamindra Maharaj Day

Back 13 October 2026

13 October 2026, BTS Group, led by Mr. Daniel Ross, Chief Investment Officer and Head of Sustainability at BTS Group Holdings Public Company Limited, together with executives and employees across BTS Group, participated in a Wreath-Laying Ceremony at the King Rama IX Memorial Park in Bangkok to commemorate Nawamindra Maharaj Day and pay tribute to His Majesty King Bhumibol Adulyadej the Great.

Through this solemn ceremony, BTS Group pay tribute to His Majesty’s boundless benevolence and expresses its enduring gratitude for His Majesty’s immeasurable contributions to the Kingdom of Thailand
